description: Land Acquisition - Hirimburagama, Uluvitike, Meepawala and Poddala, Bope-Poddala D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, including their names, assessment numbers, types (garden, road, etc.), claimants, and exact measurements. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
